# Essentia.js 0.1.3 — private local main-DJ integration

These files are independent main-application copies of the immutable Beat Lab vendor assets. They were copied locally without modification on 2026-09-05. The main DJ uses only Degara through Essentia.js; it does not import the experiment or music-tempo.
